title: High School — Institutional Routine From Inside
subtitle: Corridors, classrooms, posture drills, and ceremony without voice-over thesis
lineage: Lineage: Frederick Wiseman, High School (1968) · Supporting: SCION 080 (Salesman), SCION 082 (First Position)
theorem: Reveal how an institution shapes posture, speech, and time by linking unvarnished procedural encounters—corridor transit, classroom diagram, posture inspection, rehearsal, and graduation ceremony—without an explanatory narrator.
boundary_note: No voice-over narrator tells the viewer what to think of the institution; clips from 1949–2000 retain their own historical dates and room acoustics.
